page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Running head at the top, with the page number beside it. Text in one column, with the catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: necin ea curiose inquirat, nedum ut ad-versus ea vitilitigatione aliqua instituat.
Huius modestiae & reuerentiae Deo debitae exemplum laude dignum occur-rit in Psal.39.9. Obmutui, nō aperiam os meum: nam tu fecisti.

Ergo siue emergant & floreant impij, ac multis magnis calamitatibus pios af-ficiant: siue hi in cauffa optima laborare & deseri, siue numerus piorum ad ma-gnā paucitatem redigi, siue facta & profana misceri uideantur: nobis tamen non[?] est obloquendum Deo, nec eius iudicia accusanda: sed illud Propheticum repe-tendum: Cum sedero in tenebris, Iehouah erit illuminatio mea. Item: Iram Ie-houae portabo, quia peccaui ei. Sunt e-nim profundae diuitiae tum sapientiae, tū cognitionis Dei: inscrutabilia sunt eius iudicia, & viae eius imperuestigabiles. Quis enim cognouit mentem Domini, aut quis ei fuit a consilijs? Rom.11. 33.34. Haec de cap.2. paucis dicere licuit.

page.notes: The word "non" in "nobis tamen non est" is printed with its last letter in a different, blurred form; I read it as "non" but marked it doubtful. The "ff" in "cauffa" is the printed ligature and is kept as printed. The top of the page carries a faint ghost of the text from the other side (show-through), which was left out.
